annotations.title: Tokenized stocks across issuers and networks

description: Tokenized stocks on chain, one row per company across every issuer and network we read (Coinbase on Base; Robinhood on Robinhood Chain; xStocks on Solana, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain and others; Ondo on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana and Robinhood Chain; Dinari on Arbitrum, Ethereum and Base). Free. Each company carries its networks, issuers and tokens, and what is in issue at each issuer’s own reference value summed over networks (valueComplete false where a token has no reference value, so the sum is a floor). Supply is read on chain except for Coinbase, where it is the issuer’s. A company or network missing here is one we have not read, not one without tokenized stocks. We monitor; we issue nothing.

chain.description: Optional. One network: base, robinhood, solana, ethereum, arbitrum, bnb, optimism, hyperevm, monad.

limit.description: Optional. Rows of `companies` and `items` to return (default 25 here).

q.description: Optional. A ticker, a company name or an ISIN.

name: find_stocks

companies.description: One per company (grouped on ISIN): `name`, `isin`, `networks`, `issuers`, `tokens` (chain, address, symbol, issuer, valueUsd, page), `valueUsd`, `valueComplete`, `valueMeans`.

coverage.description: Which issuers and networks were read; anything outside it is unread, not absent.

items.description: One per token deployment, largest first: chain, address, issuer, symbol, name, isin, supply, `referenceValue` {usd, asOf, source, means}, valueUsd, control, market, page.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

minted.description: Of those, how many have supply in issue.

total.description: Token deployments matching the question, before the limit.

valued.description: Tokens that carry a reference value; the rest have no dollar figure, not zero.

valuedUsd.description: What is in issue at reference value, summed over tokens that carry one.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
